description: the Lastmade, a young woman knight with a dark chin-length bob and a straight fringe, a thin gold sunburst halo of rays behind her head, a wine-red cowl scarf, a long white cape lined in wine red, a white surcoat with gold trim over slim steel plate armour, an amber glass pauldron on her left shoulder, steel gauntlets, tall steel greaves over tan leather boots, a small brown satchel at her right hip, a narrow longsword sheathed at her left hip, a small brass hand-bell in her right hand
made_with: the PixelLab connector: Pro mode, designed from the knight turnaround (OpenArt xG2MzHS0kKCoEDzuSHrs), in the style of character 4c792929-0c79-4756-ac70-6b3ca51f4a52 (Tam); walk from the walking template, battle idle from the idle-breathing template, attack, cast and hurt as custom PixMiniMax animations
walk: remade 27 November 2026 with the V3 walking action (PixelLab animation "walk-v3", 8 frames), which starts from her standing sprite: the walk template had redrawn her without her cape, sword and bell
fixed_by_hand: every north-facing frame (standing, walk, battle): her halo, taken from the front view with the whole ring showing, and the amber pauldron on her left shoulder, the front view's mirrored
every west-facing frame (standing, walk): the pauldron, taken from the south-west view
fix_tool: a script kept outside the repository (fix-items.mjs) finds her head in each frame and sets the pieces by it; the frames here are its output
